purpose: Track revised PEP primary mathematics volume identity, sequence verification, rollout status and remaining artifact-level metadata without mixing legacy editions.

current_series.series_name: Revised PEP Primary Mathematics / PEP 12th-series generation
current_series.launch_evidence: PEP states that the 12th series began use in starting grades from autumn 2024.
current_series.rollout_rule: Series structure does not prove simultaneous locality-specific adoption. Never infer mathematics rollout from notices for other subjects.
current_series.edition_rule: Legacy PEP digital books remain separate and must never be selected as current revised-series sequence evidence.

verification_dimensions.series_sequence: Grade + semester + ordered unit/activity titles in the revised series.
verification_dimensions.volume_artifact_metadata: ISBN, publication/impression metadata and official volume-level catalog/digital asset.
verification_dimensions.subsection_page_detail: Subsection headings, example numbers, exercise pages and teacher-guide page locators.
verification_dimensions.local_rollout: Whether a locality/school was using the specific revised volume at a specific date.

legacy_digital_reference.warning: Earlier illustrated edition; not revised-series sequence.

volumes.warning: Some third-party pages labelled new textbook still reproduce the older sequence; use the publisher-authored series table as sequence authority.

ui_rule: When PEP revised series is selected, exact grade/semester/unit placement may now be shown from the verified series table. Do not imply nationwide PEP use, simultaneous rollout, or subsection/page detail that has not been separately verified.
